title: Flex my Item
description: Flex your item in your server!
body:
# 💪 Flex my Item

Don't just link your items. FLEX them.

Are you tired of flexers without proof? Do you want to prove that you have zero life outside of Minecraft? Flex my Item is the chat enhancement mod that turns showing off your gear into a server-wide event.

Whether you're holding a God-Tier Netherite Sword or a single Poisonous Potato, this mod knows exactly how to handle it.

Smart Context: analyzes your item and roasts (or praises) you automatically!

        Holding trash? "Player awkwardly offers you some Dirt."

        Holding God Gear? "Player unleashes the power of their Netherite Sword!"

        Near Broken gear? "Player is holding on for dear life to their Shield."

        Visual FX: Spawns actual particles around your character in-game (Stars for rare loot, Smoke for common junk).

        Sound Effects: Plays a satisfying DING or RESONATE sound to everyone nearby so they have to look at you.

### 📜 Commands

        /flex - The main command. Hold an item and run this to show it off.

        Includes a built-in cooldown to prevent chat spam (your arm gets tired!).

![mod showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1b1fde62c49e5a22df5bfe0100763ebf37f5b7b6.png)

ℹ️ Server-Side Friendly! 

- (Clients don't strictly need it to see the text, but having it installed enables the particles/sounds properly heard.

💬 "Why did you make this?"

- Because simply saying "I have a sword" isn't enough. I needed the world to hear the ding, see the particles!

**Ready to show off? Download Flex my Item today.**

#### Inspired by SilverAndro's [ItemFlexer](https://modrinth.com/mod/itemflexer)! 💪
#### You can put this mod on your modpacks! A shout out will do 😉
